extracted.name: Dairy Free Tuscan Chicken Soup
ingredient_lines: Ingredients from original recipe with these changes:
Left-over chicken, we did a beer-butt chicken on the grill, used the leftovers here
~2 quarts of chicken stock or broth (I only used 1)
1-2 cans full fat coconut milk (I used 1)
Kale (remove ribs and chop) - I didn’t add this but doubled the spinach
More sun dried tomatoes and/or can of diced tomatoes
instruction_lines: Cook chicken in sun dried tomato oil as recipe describes. Set aside (will chop and add to soup at the end)
Sauté onions and mushrooms then add chopped garlic and Italian seasoning at the end
Add chicken stock, coconut milk, yeast flakes, pepper, salt. (can add chopped asparagus)
Bring to a simmer approx. 10 minutes
Add Kale if you plan to do so (takes longer than Spinach) simmer about 5 minutes
Add Spinach, beans, sun dried tomatoes, and chicken
Simmer 5 minutes until spinach, kale and asparagus are ready
